title: Private Tenancy Readiness Index & OKR Commitment Matrix — Q3 Roadmap
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create and operationalize a Quarterly 'Private Tenancy Readiness Index' (PTRI) and an accompanying OKR Commitment Matrix to align product, infra, security, and customer success on activation readiness for Private/VPC/on-prem feature rollouts. The PTRI is a scored rubric used to gate tranche activations; the OKR Commitment Matrix translates roadmap commitments into measurable signals and owners. Deliverables: 1) Scoring rubric (infra/capacity, compliance, performance, upgrade window, support ops, telemetry), 2) OKR matrix mapping features to success signals and SLAs, 3) rollout gating checklist and escalation playbook, 4) stakeholder sign-off template and cadence for weekly readiness reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented with weightings for at least 6 readiness signals and sample scores for 3 pilot tenants
OKR Commitment Matrix populated for all Q3 Private/VPC features with owner and target metric for each feature
Automated dashboard (Grafana) created showing PTRI score per tenant and per tranche with drilldowns
Rollout gating checklist added to Console runbook and linked in on-call playbook
Stakeholder sign-off session completed and recorded; roll/no-roll decision example documented
